title: Association List of Operators
description: Define ops as a list of cons pairs, each pairing a symbol like '+ with the corresponding procedure like +.

steps.description: Reveal the complete definition of ops as an association list.
Focus on structure: list of four cons pairs, each with symbol and procedure.
Focus on cons pairs: (cons '+ +) pairs the symbol '+ with the addition procedure.
Focus on alist: ops is a lookup table using familiar list, cons, car, cdr operations.
